disposal.rule: std::string SSO: temp pointer equal to the temp's own +0x10 slot address frees nothing; otherwise delete(pointer, capacity + 1) with capacity from +0x10

gate.rule: both qwords zero zeroes the destination (bytes 0-5 and 8-15; bytes 6-7 never written) and returns at once with no setup, walk, virtual call or disposal; either non-zero proceeds

landing_pad.cleanup: disposes the temp string (std::string _M_dispose on the temp slot at rsp) and resumes unwinding with rbx; recorded, not modelled as a normal return
landing_pad.entry: 0x5d51fdf inside the routine FDE, saves the incoming value in rbx and jumps to the cleanup block

not_claimed: what the setup callees 0x60a1500 and 0x603d410 compute
what the source fields, the nodes, the vtable slot or the sentinel denote

setup.opaque: what the callee computes is not pinned
what the callee computes is not pinned; it fills the 32-byte string-shaped temp

trailing_bytes: the single byte after the FDE range, 0x5d51feb, is int3 padding before the next FDE at 0x5d51fec; the int3 padding at 0x5d51e93..0x5d51ea0 follows the cleanup block, not this routine

walk.first_node_comparison: first node's slot against the sentinel qword at 0x64ed1b8
walk.head: source +0x318
walk.rule: the first node whose vtable slot differs from its predecessor's slot is called through that slot with (destination, node, temp slot); if the first four nodes all carry the same slot, the fifth node is called through its slot unconditionally
